headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw a 43-yard touchdown pass to Tyler Lockett late in the first half, Marshawn Lynch jumped the pile for a 1-yard score, and the Seattle Seahawks beat the San Francisco 49ers 20-
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson, Seahawks rebound in road win over 49ers

headlines.description: Blake Bortles threw a touchdown pass to Allen Hurns with 2:16 remaining and the Jacksonville Jaguars rallied for a 34-31 win over Buffalo Bills on Sunday at Wembley Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars hold on to beat Bills 34-31 in London

headlines.description: Teddy Bridgewater threw for a season-high 316 yards and two touchdowns, and the Minnesota Vikings beat the Detroit Lions 28-19 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bridgewater, Peterson help Vikings roar past Lions 28-19

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw for 251 yards and a touchdown pass, and Devonta Freeman ran for 116 yards as the Atlanta Falcons held off the Tennessee Titans 10-7 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman runs for 116 yards as Falcons edge Titans 10-7

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw for 255 yards and one touchdown, Khiry Robinson ran for two scores and the New Orleans Saints held off the Indianapolis Colts' late comeback try for a 27-21 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints keep Colts in check, hold on for 27-21 victory

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw for 251 yards and a touchdown, Cairo Santos kicked three field goals and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the injury-filled Pittsburgh Steelers 23-13 on Sunday to snap a five-game los
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs turn back Steelers 23-13 to snap 5-game losing streak

events.name: Cleveland Browns at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Rookie Todd Gurley rushed for 128 yards and his first two touchdowns, helping the St. Louis Rams put away the punchless Cleveland Browns 24-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gurley scores 2 TDs, Rams rout Browns 24-6

headlines.description: The Miami Dolphins became the first team since at least 1940 to score four offensive touchdowns of at least 50 yards in a half, and they beat the Houston Texans 44-26 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: 4 big plays early help Dolphins drub Texans 44-26

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady overcame New England's shaky first three quarters by throwing for a pair of touchdowns in the fourth, and the Patriots beat the New York Jets 30-23 on Sunday to remain unbeaten.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, unbeaten Patriots turn it on in 4th, beat Jets 30-23

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw three second-half touchdown passes, including the go-ahead score with 24 seconds left, to lead the Washington Redskins to the largest comeback in franchise history, a 31-30 vic
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins' 3rd TD pass of 2nd half lifts Redskins past Bucs 31-30

events.name: Oakland Raiders at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw three touchdown passes, including a 52-yarder to Amari Cooper, and the Oakland Raiders turned two interceptions of Philip Rivers into 10 points on their way to an easy 37-29 vict
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr throws 3 TD passes, Raiders embarrass Chargers 37-29

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: Dwayne Harris sped 100 yards with a kickoff return against his former Dallas teammates seconds after the Cowboys had tied Sunday's game, and the New York Giants moved atop the NFC East with a 27-
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants take advantage of Cowboys' mistakes, win 27-20

headlines.description: Cam Newton and the Carolina Panthers defeated the Philadelphia Eagles 27-16 on Monday night to improve to 6-0 for the first time in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Tolbert lead perfect Panthers over Eagles 27-16

headlines.description: Chris Johnson rushed for 122 yards, including 62 on one play, and the Arizona Cardinals held off a late rally to beat the Baltimore Ravens.
